newsitem.title: USA: Sears stock dips amid concern over settlement.
newsitem.headline: Sears stock dips amid concern over settlement.

text.p: Sears, Reobuck and Co's shares fell Wednesday amid concerns about the retailer's recent sales weakness and the cost of settling litigation alleging the its credit card collection methods were illegal.

Sears earlier agreed to a settlement with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission to make refunds of $100 million to Sears credit card customers who were persuaded to agree to pay the company money after filing for bankruptcy.
The FTC charged the retailer had illegally forced consumers to pay money they did not owe in cases dating back to 1985.
